classification: bounded command projection with world, spline and physical-effect adapters

entry.description: Non-first calls complete without resolving arguments or spawning. Every path returns EAX=1; Ghidra presents the entrypoint as void. Two return tails follow the first ret.

parsing.description: Each token takes the first matching branch of a fixed ordered scan: mingroupsize, maxgroupsize, groupsize, type, script, mindistance, maxdistance, distance, use_selected_spline, splines=, spline=myspline, spline=, x/y/z_offset=, looping, addtoset=myset, addtoset=, relative_to_player, relative_to_locator=, ridden_by=myself, ridden_by=. Key/value forms are case-insensitive substring matches with fixed skips; bare flags are whole-token case-insensitive equality. "type" is a bare substring matched before every later key, so any token containing it is consumed as a type. use_selected_spline is only recognized while the selected-spline global 0x876d94 is non-null; otherwise the token falls through and is ignored. Scalars use original 0x5147c0; group sizes and numeric addtoset truncate through ftol.

types.description: Up to ten short type IDs. Both type callbacks are required: byte ID255 and resolved ID-1 are rejected; callbacks still execute after the cap. Unlike CreateCreatures there is no hub, RandomMap or generic-goon path. One integer-RNG draw selects one type for every creature of the call, after the spline draw.

splines.description: Thirty-two spline slots. spline= takes the first case-insensitively equal name from the world+0x13c table (0x5d0690) and is bounded. splines= appends every name with the operand as a case-insensitive prefix (0x5d0740 via 0x4f8b80, length strlen(pattern)), limited to the remaining capacity; 0x4f8b80 always compares at least one byte, so an empty operand matches no non-empty name. spline=myspline appends packet+0xac when non-null WITHOUT a bound: index32 overwrites the first two type IDs in the native frame; the portable core rejects it. use_selected_spline wins over listed splines; otherwise the 16-bit LCG at 0x80253c (state*0x24cd+1) chooses index state/(0xffff/count+1).

countAndDistance.description: Default count1, minimum/maximum -1. Only when tokens exist, minimum>=0 and maximum>minimum, one shared integer-RNG draw chooses count inclusively; equal endpoints do NOT replace the count (differs from CreateCreatures). Default distance0, min/max distance 1e9. When both bounds differ from 1e9, one float-RNG draw r computes (1-r)*min+r*max in x87 precision, overwriting any explicit distance. Nothing spawns unless (selected or a listed spline), at least one type and count>0.

spawnArguments.description: Allocator 0x43d890 receives the type (sign-extended short), null position, zero heading, script (default "default"), three zeros, the chosen spline, a pointer to the authored offset vector, the looping flag and addtoset; once per count. addtoset=myset uses packet byte+0xb0. Failed allocations consume attempts.

relativePlacement.description: On a non-null actor with relative_to_player or a resolved relative_to_locator: two limits start at -1 and, only when world+0x128 equals global 0x87b0a0, come from 0x4dca00(spline). 0x551c40(base, out, spline, looping, first, second) builds an eight-word follower copied over actor+0xe64; the base is player+0x80 when relative_to_player is set, else locator+0x10.

evidence.excerpt: 0044a897  rep movsd dword ptr es:[edi], dword ptr [esi]

distancePlacement.description: When distance!=0 (or NaN): advance the follower (0x5518a0), evaluate its spline at follower time+0x1c with signed mode byte+0x6 (0x550a20). Store heading in +0x58/+0x5a/+0x27a and -pitch in +0x278. If the actor offset at +0xe84 is non-zero, rotate it about X by -pitch then Y by heading with the original LUT helpers and add it. Copy the position to +0x5c, +0x98, +0x80, globals 0x93d620, +0x8c, call 0x55d2b0, then copy the updated +0x5c into +0x1b4 and +0x10bc. With distance0 no follower or position is touched.

rider.description: ridden_by=myself requires self and its +0xd0 reference and reads the first word (possibly null); ridden_by= resolves through 0x440120 and overwrites. A non-null rider is attached with 0x488730(rider, actor, 0, 1) after placement, including when distance is zero.

verification.method: Original PC body plus original string, spline-table, numeric, RNG and vector helpers against an independent Python contract model; explicit world service hooks. Compiled C# comparison is a separate pending stage.

variants: allocations succeed with level spline limits active
allocations succeed without a selected spline
sourceCoverage.qualification: Authored arguments are exact catalog values. The selected spline, spline table, world bindings and type metadata are synthetic; these results are not claims about runtime reachability in live levels. 86 shipped uses depend on use_selected_spline, i.e. on a prior selected-spline global (SelectRandomSpline is not yet contracted). noSpawnSources come only from the synthetic type fixture, which resolves hash slot 7 to -1 to exercise rejection.

portable.compiledStatus: C#5-compatible core and unified verifier harness compile successfully. Managed differential execution remains pending under the Windows execution denial (Defender ASR prevalence rule).
adapters: SplineSpawnServices resolves type, locator and rider references; the spline table is context data scanned by the portable core.

Allocation, relative-follower construction, level spline limits, follower advance, spline evaluation and post-placement update are services; only their arguments, order and field effects are established.
Shared integer, float and 16-bit RNG ownership remains host-supplied; native state and draw order are compared in fixtures.
AngleTable supplies the original sine LUT; rotation is exercised on cardinal fixture angles only.
hostGuards: Reject a 33rd spline=myspline candidate instead of overwriting the type array.
Reject out-of-int32/nonfinite numeric operands, tokens whose fixed skip passes their terminator, scripts beyond 63 characters, and spawn counts beyond the operation budget.
portable.precision: Distance lerp reproduces x87 64-bit-mantissa rounding via exact double products plus a two-sum midpoint correction; rotation arithmetic is exact for cardinal LUT values only.

remaining: World/name/type/locator/rider/allocation/spline-evaluation/effect calls are explicit fixture adapters. The original parser, loop, spline-name table scans (0x5d0690/0x5d0740), scalar evaluator, all three RNGs and cardinal vector helpers execute unchanged.
The synthetic spline table holds every authored spline=/splines= name; it does not establish which splines exist in a live level.
Spline follower layout beyond the fields this command touches, spline evaluation and post-placement update are services.
Actor comparisons cover documented fields, not every byte or downstream effects.
The 33rd spline=myspline write past the native 32-entry array, nonfinite operands, and tokens whose fixed skip passes their terminator are outside the bounded core.
Compiled C# differential execution remains pending under the Windows execution denial.
